Name: Azariah, the Priest
Summary: Azariah the priest went in after Uzziah with eighty valiant priests and withstood the king for burning incense, which belonged to the consecrated sons of Aaron; he then saw the leprosy and thrust Uzziah out.
KeyStory: Azariah and the priests told Uzziah to go out of the sanctuary, for he had trespassed, and they thrust him out when leprosy rose in his forehead.
LifeLesson: Eighty priests standing together could tell a king what one voice could not.
